updates.title: Discontinuation of JEE Main for Future Cycles & Separate Test Announcement
updates.summary: IIT Kanpur officially announced via WSAIS FAQ 23 that JEE Main will no longer be used for future B.Cyber admissions, and that a dedicated separate entrance test will be conducted.

officialSource.title: IIT Kanpur WSAIS Official Portal — FAQ 23
officialSource.verbatimQuote: Will the same admission process be followed for future admissions? JEE Mains will not be used. A separate entrance test will be announced, the details of which will be made available soon.

updates.implicationsForStudents: Crucial strategic shift for future aspirants: JEE Main will not be used for admission. Future applicants must await the official announcement for the entrance test format, syllabus, and eligibility rules. In the interim, computing and problem-solving studies are independent educational recommendations only, with no assumption that they represent the future test syllabus.

updates.title: B.Cyber 2026 Results & Seat Allotment Announced
updates.summary: IIT Kanpur published the list of candidates selected for the inaugural B.Cyber batch following the 5th July on-campus assessment round.

officialSource.title: IIT Kanpur WSAIS Notification Marquee & Results Sheet
officialSource.verbatimQuote: B.Cyber Admissions 2026: Seat Allotment Announced – Click here to view. | List of Candidates for B.Cyber 2026 Announced - Click here to view.

updates.implicationsForStudents: Selected candidates were instructed to report to the IIT Kanpur campus for orientation and registration by 21st July 2026.

updates.title: Inaugural On-Campus Admission Test & Hackathon Held at IIT Kanpur
updates.summary: Shortlisted candidates attended a 6-hour hands-on technical evaluation at the New Core Lab, IIT Kanpur, covering Web, API, OSINT, Reverse Engineering, and Cryptography.

officialSource.title: IIT Kanpur WSAIS Test Details & Venue Schedule
officialSource.verbatimQuote: Date: 05 July 2026. Venue: New Core Lab, IIT Kanpur. Test Duration: 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM.

updates.implicationsForStudents: Established the precedent that the admissions committee places high value on hands-on terminal stamina and real-time problem triage under supervised conditions.

updates.title: IIT Madras Launches B.Cyber Program from AY 2026-27
updates.summary: IIT Madras officially announced the launch of its own B.Cyber degree program, joining the admission channel conducted by IIT Kanpur for the 2026-27 cycle.

officialSource.title: IIT Kanpur WSAIS Special Announcement & IITM PDF
officialSource.verbatimQuote: IIT Madras launches the B.Cyber. program from academic year 2026-27. The admission to the program will be via the test being conducted by IIT Kanpur on 5th July 2026.

updates.implicationsForStudents: Confirms that candidates admitted to IIT Madras study at IIT Madras and receive their degree from IIT Madras, expanding institutional capacity for practice-oriented cybersecurity education in India.

updates.title: Inaugural Application Form & Portal Launch for 2026 Batch
updates.summary: WSAIS opened the formal application window for B.Cyber 2026 with an application deadline of 25th June 2026.

officialSource.title: IIT Kanpur WSAIS Tentative Timeline
officialSource.verbatimQuote: Portal launch and application form opening: 15th June 2026. Last date to apply: 25th June 2026.

updates.implicationsForStudents: Illustrates that inaugural admission notifications can have compressed application turnarounds (10-day application window in 2026).
